name: kakuro
description: 加算十字 Kakuro — 零猜测交叉和推理. 出题时由铅笔求解器实测：每一局都唯一可解、且只用组合清单交集与进差法就能推到底, 难度分与档位区间都是量出来的.

scripts.check: for f in js/*.js js/*/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && node --check server.cjs && node --check electron/main.cjs && node --check electron/preload.cjs && for f in tools/*.mjs tools/*.cjs tools/*.js; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; node --check "$f" || exit 1; done && test -f index.html && grep -q '<canvas' index.html && grep -q 'js/main.js' index.html && grep -q 'window.kakuro' js/main.js && echo OK

author: z-biz-game
